description: The "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" project, created by Team Sunoom, is an interactive digital children story tailored for school-age and casual space enthusiasts.
summary: The "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" project, created by Team Sunoom, is an interactive digital story tailored for school-age and casual space enthusiasts about the hardware left on the Moon, Mars, and elsewhere. It offers an engaging process of the journey and their significant tasks. This initiative aims to enhance their understanding of these hardware and journeys. Through compelling storytelling, interactive simulations, and the integration of real NASA satellite data, "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" empowers them with knowledge and fosters a greater awareness of how these explorers operated in Moon and Mars, ultimately walk away feeling a personal connection to these forgotten robotic explorers and inspired by the science they conducted.
details:
HOW I ADDRESSED THE CHALLENGE

In response to this challenge, I developed "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" a web-based educational children's story designed as a visual representation to engage everyone especially to school-age space enthusiasts. This comprehensive tool emphasizes the significant story of some of this equipment, the hardware and the science it made possible.

In "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" readers engage in an educational storytelling experience that consists of two key components: a reading phase and a watching phase.

The story begins with a visualization of website home, enabling users to choose between 2 stories directly.


Following this, they can read / watch while engage in the narration to understand the journey by the equipment, the hardware and the science it made possible.


HOW I DEVELOPED THIS PROJECT

This project works by presenting an interactive digital school-age space enthusiasts’ story that clearly illustrates the point of view of equipment in a simple and engaging way.

To bring this vision to fruition, I integrated guides in the digital school-age story to ease the readers. "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" is accessible across all browsers, supporting both touch screen or mouse-click functionality, depending on the device being used, whether it be a computer or smartphone.

The digital story covers these main points:

1. Project Overview and Main Objective

The main objective of this project is to develop an interactive storytelling website that showcases two significant robotic and space exploration stories: the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector on the Moon and the Mars Pathfinder mission, including its Sojourner rover on Mars.

The website aims to present historical space exploration and scientific discoveries through storytelling rather than simply displaying historical facts and mission information. By combining factual information with interactive digital content, the project seeks to help audiences understand how these technologies operated, the purposes they served, and their contributions to scientific knowledge.

The two missions will be presented through different storytelling formats to create an engaging learning experience while maintaining historical and scientific accuracy.

2. Storytelling Approach and Presentation Medium

The project will use an interactive website as its primary presentation medium. Instead of presenting the information through a conventional timeline or a list of historical events, the website will organise the content into two separate storytelling experiences.

A. Apollo 11 – Interactive Reading Story

  • Presentation format: A digital reading story accompanied by calm background melodies.
  • Storytelling approach: The Apollo 11 story will focus on the lunar retroreflector, commonly known as the Moon mirror, left on the Moon during the Apollo 11 mission.
  • Historical and scientific focus: The story will explain show scientists on Earth send laser pulses towards the mirror and measure the reflected light to determine the distance between the Earth and the Moon.
  • Learning objective: Through the reading experience, audiences can understand how a relatively small piece of equipment left on the lunar surface continues to contribute to scientific research.
  • Audience experience: The combination of storytelling, reading and calm background music is intended to create an engaging and comfortable learning experience.

B. Mars Pathfinder and Sojourner – Short Story Video

  • Presentation format: A short digital storytelling video.
  • Storytelling approach: The video will showcase the journey of Mars Pathfinder and its Sojourner rover through a narrative-based presentation.
  • Historical and scientific focus: The story will introduce the Mars Pathfinder mission, explain the role of the Sojourner rover and showcase its exploration of the Martian surface.
  • Learning objective: The video aims to help audiences understand how the Pathfinder lander and Sojourner rover operated on Mars and how their exploration contributed to our understanding of the planet.
  • Audience experience: By presenting the mission through a short story video, audiences can follow the exploration journey and understand the mission through visual storytelling.

3. Connecting Engineering Technology with Scientific Discoveries

An important objective of this project is to establish a connection between the engineering of space exploration equipment and the scientific knowledge gained from these missions.

Rather than simply introducing the equipment and its technical specifications, the website will highlight their functions and purposes within the storytelling.

Apollo 11: Lunar Retroreflector

  • Highlight the purpose of the retroreflector placed on the Moon.
  • Highlight how this equipment continues to support scientific research long after the Apollo 11 mission.

Mars Pathfinder and Sojourner:

  • Introduce the Mars Pathfinder lander and its role in the mission.
  • Explain how Sojourner explored the Martian surface.
  • Highlight the scientific information and knowledge gained through the mission.

Through these two stories, audiences will gain a better understanding of how space exploration technologies were designed for specific purposes and how their functions contributed to scientific discoveries.

4. Target Audience and Accessibility

The interactive storytelling website is intended to make historical space exploration and scientific information easier for audiences to understand.

  • Target audience: The content is designed to be accessible to general audiences, particularly younger audiences and students who are interested in space exploration and science.
  • Simplified storytelling: Historical and scientific information will be communicated through straightforward narrative language rather than relying entirely on technical explanations.
  • Multiple presentation formats: The website will provide two different ways of experiencing the stories: a reading experience for Apollo 11 and a short video experience for Mars Pathfinder and Sojourner.
  • Audio and visual elements: Background melodies, illustrations and video content will support the presentation of the stories and make the information more engaging. Artwork technique being used is soft pastel technique and Roman mosaic technique that are usually used in art class that are familiar with school-age audiences' activities.

These approaches aim to make scientific and historical information more approachable without compromising factual accuracy.

5. Historical Accuracy and Use of Mission Information

Historical accuracy is an important consideration throughout the development of the website. The storytelling will incorporate real historical facts, mission information and scientific explanations to ensure that the content accurately represents the achievements of both missions.

The Apollo 11 story will focus on the lunar retroreflector and its continued scientific purpose.

The Mars story will focus on the Mars Pathfinder mission and Sojourner rover, including their exploration activities and scientific contributions.

Creative storytelling will be used as a presentation method, but the historical events, equipment functions and scientific explanations must remain consistent with documented mission information which are also included in the end of the story / video.

The intention is to ensure that audiences can distinguish between the storytelling presentation and the actual historical and scientific facts.

6. Intended Learning Outcomes and Project Impact

By the end of the interactive storytelling experience, audiences should be able to understand the significance of these space exploration missions beyond their historical achievements.

The intended outcomes include:

  • Understanding the purpose and continued scientific importance of the Apollo 11 lunar retroreflector.
  • Understanding how laser ranging technology allows scientists to measure the distance between Earth and the Moon.
  • Understanding the purpose of the Mars Pathfinder mission and the role of the Sojourner rover.
  • Recognising how robotic exploration allows scientists to investigate environments beyond Earth.
  • Appreciating how engineering technologies contribute to scientific discoveries and expand humanity's understanding of space.

Ultimately, the project aims to create a meaningful connection between audiences and these historical space exploration missions. Through interactive reading and short video storytelling, the website will bring attention to the scientific achievements of these robotic explorers and encourage audiences to appreciate the role of technology in advancing human knowledge.

HOPE TO ACHIEVE

My objective with "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" is to create an engaging and accessible learning experience about significant story of some of this equipment, the hardware and the science it made possible. I aspire to contribute to a more informed and environmentally conscious generation. By offering a platform that combines education with interactive experiences, I aim to foster a deeper appreciation for science it made possible. Ultimately, I hope to inspire readers to become advocates for space journey. Therefore, this digital school-age space enthusiasts story is created for the next generation to spark their love for the journey and become the large community of space explorers.

Important Note

One notable aspect of "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" is its holistic approach to education. It functions not only as a school-age space enthusiasts' story but also as a dynamic learning resource. Readers can engage in reading activities and watching short video or reading the story, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the significant story of some of this equipment, the hardware and the science it made possible. This digital school-age space enthusiasts' story can be read by all ages and community.

Highlighted Features

  • Engaging narrative content
  • User-friendly comical story interface
  • Integration of real NASA satellite data and images


Tools Used

  • Capcut:Generated visually appealing videos.
  • Canva:Generated visually appealing graphics, including in-game images and designs.

For "Abandoned But Not Forgotten" project, I employed several SI tools and software to enhance various aspects:

- Audio: Songs are from Canva and Capcut free music.
- Images: All images are generated by ChatGPT and Google Flow.

  • ChatGPT: Utilized for level design, game architecture, and script generation for videos.
  • Google Flow: Ensured that scripts adhered to specific time constraints for effective video narration.
  • ChatGPT: Generated visually appealing graphics, including in-game images and character designs.
